passages.original: His coss. Justinus philosophus librum pro Christiana religione scriptum tradidit Antonino.
passages.english: In the consulship of these [men], Justin the philosopher handed over to Antoninus a book written in defence of the Christian religion.
passages.notes: "His coss." (his consulibus) refers to consuls named in the preceding entry of the chronicle, which is not given here.
